The '''''Indefatigable''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that was used by the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the Thaereian fleet during the [[Blockade of the Cularin system]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jir Tramsig]], the fleet commander was stationed aboard it. It participated in the [[Battle of Cularin (21 BBY)|Battle of Cularin]] and was destroyed after a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] fleet joined the battle.
